# Licenses in Florida

> Licensing, compliance, tax, and staffing support for medical clinics and healthcare locations opening in Florida.

## About

Licenses in Florida helps clinic owners and medical entrepreneurs navigate Florida business permits, AHCA healthcare clinic licensing, Medicare/Medicaid enrollment, Sunbiz entity formation, tax services, and clinical staffing.

Website: https://licencesinflorida.com
Phone / WhatsApp: (786) 253-7699
Email: info@licensingflorida.com

## Services

- [Business Licensing](https://licencesinflorida.com/business-licensing.html): Certificate of Use, sewer approval, DER, Miami-Dade Local Business Tax (LBT)
- [Clinic Licensing](https://licencesinflorida.com/clinic-licensing.html): AHCA, Medicare, Medicaid, CLIA, DEA, MPI, NPI, DUN, Registry Number
- [Business Formation](https://licencesinflorida.com/business-formation.html): Sunbiz Corp/LLC, public notary, apostille
- [Tax Services](https://licencesinflorida.com/tax-services.html): Commercial, corporate, and personal income tax
- [Staffing](https://licencesinflorida.com/staffing.html): Medical directors, GPs, APRNs, RNs, therapy technicians, phlebotomists
